name: per-user-session-cap
prompt: A runaway client can create unbounded sessions for one user. Add a per-user cap: add field MaxPerUser int to Store, set via an option-style constructor NewStoreWithCap(ttl time.Duration, maxPerUser int) (keep NewStore unchanged and make it set MaxPerUser to 0, meaning unlimited). Store.Create must return a new error ErrUserAtCap (define it) when the user already holds MaxPerUser live sessions (with MaxPerUser > 0), and in that case must not create the session. Live means the same rule Get uses. Update main.go's POST handler to answer 429 Too Many Requests when Create returns ErrUserAtCap.
